title: Asymptotic dimension identity
statement: For each natural number $w$, let $D(w)=w s(w)$, where $s(w)$ is the greatest natural number at most $2^{w+2}$ satisfying $1-(1-2^{-w})^{s(w)}\le \tfrac12$, and let $E(w)=2^w\log(D(w))/D(w)-1$. For all sufficiently large $w$, $2^w=\frac{D(w)}{\log(D(w))}(1+E(w))$.
